g.text: Tear down who each app model really charges
Decide: one platform, mode as a setting
Total cost next to the button, on every order
Plain language as a build constraint from day one
Beginner mode v1: confirmations on everything
People felt talked down to. Explain on hover, confirm above a threshold.
Pro mode v1: stripped for cleanliness
Pros needed density. Put it back.
Not shipped. The reasoning is the deliverable.
